d: West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee expressed strong solidarity with youth activists and student leaders associated with the movement against the Election Commission, commending them for their dedication despite facing hardships. "They are the pioneer and they are the founder of this movement," Banerjee said, highlighting that the young leaders have extended their full backing to the scheduled rally.
